implementation.anchor: Immutable material mask and original jittered triangle/side/barycentric weights are built with each cover chunk. Hard terrain is marked inactive; ambiguous competing roots near loose terrain are omitted, including exact shared-edge roots.
implementation.runtime: The vertex shader fetches three original vertices and uses GroundSurfaceShader.TRIANGLE_QUERY/query_elevation. The existing installed tile table selects coarse vs 16-way subdivision. Existing SoftGroundField texture/clock supply tracks, fade and eviction. No extra track image, per-frame cover upload or GPU readback.
implementation.ownership: EITerrain weakly caches GroundSurfaceData. Cover and GroundContact own enabled lifetimes. Cover alone skips contact-light normals/upper bounds; a later contact bind upgrades the vertex texture in place with stable RID. Hard-only maps allocate no cover surface texture.
implementation.cost: Four extra float32 mesh values per cover vertex; one 16-byte-per-grid-vertex map texture on loose maps while enabled, shared with contact. A one-byte-per-tile immutable loose mask. Deformation keeps TIME*0.0 to refresh cached local shadows, including with wind and pressure off.
implementation.policy: No option default, desktop continuous-sun policy, Android/web held fallback, gameplay, save or network-protocol changes. No installed builds or original assets modified.

limits: Whole cover objects translate vertically at the root; rigid litter retains its original orientation and may intersect or span a narrow footprint at its outer edges. This is not a snow-mound conforming mesh or physics simulation.

Desktop renderers only. No Android/browser FPS, memory, energy or upload-time acceptance; RTX 3090 viewport timings are not device benchmarks. Short single-order timing samples are noisy, especially the fresh-cache sand run; no speedup is established.

Ambiguous roots are conservatively omitted, not dynamically switched between overlapping surfaces. Ordinary sampled base-map placement counts stayed unchanged; boundary probes omit two of 1024 points in the snow scene.
No dynamic removal of unused custom vertex attributes; all cover vertices store the 16-byte anchor even with soft ground off. No extra geometry texture on hard-only maps.
Contact normals remain resident while another consumer still owns an upgraded shared snapshot; all optional geometry resources release when the last consumer disables.

These are bounded full-scene fixtures with manual contacts, not long gameplay routes or creature/navigation tests. Water-level round trips and shared uniform rebinding are covered; exhaustive shoreline attenuation and all campaign profiles are not.

Reeds/swamp, verified sea shore/underwater cover, snow/sand mounds, wider region/species profiles, shared weather wind and submission-efficient LOD remain open. U45 remains first in the later gameplay track.
